title: 公園用ブランコ
description: A型フレーム、接合金具、シャックル、交互のチェーンリンクと座席を備える静的なブランコ。安全規格適合は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A static playground swing with connected A-frame, spreaders, shackles, alternating chain links and rubber seat. Safety-standard compliance has not been validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
